subject: Post-demo: usage deck, credits path and committed-use options for Soloha
messages:

Subject: Post-demo: usage deck, credits path and committed-use options for Soloha

Hi Sam / Leila —

Great demo earlier — thanks for walking through the ingestion pipeline and the live assist flows. Quick recap and next steps so everything is captured: 

- Consumption signal: you called out ~350M tokens/month initially (mainly embeddings + short chat responses) ramping to ~1.2B tokens by month 6 if pilot expands to support customer-facing features. I noted the split roughly 60% embeddings, 40% generation.
- Primary ask: clarity on target unit $/1M tokens and whether Soloha qualifies for startup credits or a committed-use discount (12–24 month).
- Short-term proposal (what I'll send today): a) cost ranges for the two volume buckets you mentioned, b) an example committed-use schedule (6mo/12mo/24mo) with the corresponding effective $/1M numbers, c) an initial mutual action plan (MAP) to keep the pilot on track.

Attachments: soloha_usage_estimate.xlsx (your numbers + my model), redwood_startup_program.pdf (eligibility + benefits), mutual_action_plan.docx (draft MAP).

Action items: 
1) Sam — can you confirm the 350M / 1.2B token trajectory and whether the 60/40 split is stable across customers?
2) Leila — what internal procurement timeline should we plan for if you want to pursue a committed discount?
3) Ben / Marissa — any thoughts on a founder track credit and whether we should propose a steeper first-year ramp (we discussed a founders sweetener on the call)?

Thanks — sending the model and MAP now. Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if useful.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: soloha_usage_estimate.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB), redwood_startup_program.pdf (pdf, 420KB), mutual_action_plan.docx (docx, 28KB)
From: Sam Park <sam@soloha.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leila Gomez <leila@soloha.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage deck, credits path and committed-use options for Soloha

Aisha — thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachments. Helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Numbers: the 350M/month is a conservative pilot baseline (QA + internal tooling plus 2 small customers). If pilot goes well, our engineering roadmap pushes us toward full customer conversion in Q1 — that's where the 1.2B/month estimate comes from. The 60/40 split should hold for the next 3–4 months; after that we expect generation to climb as we add more chat scenarios.
- Budget: current FY budget for LLM infra is ~$60k/month but we have runway stretch if we can secure a committed discount or startup credits that materially lower unit cost.
- Target unit: ideally we're aiming for ~$500–$700 / 1M tokens effective cost at scale (post-discount) — that's our threshold to keep the product economics intact. If Redwood can get us within that band with a 12–24 month committed structure, procurement will prioritize you.

Ask: would you be able to pull together an explicit committed-use comparison that shows: list price, founders/startup credits applied, 12mo committed discount schedule, and 24mo schedule (including any multi-year sweeteners or volume tiers)? If you can show an example where we hit ~$600 / 1M at ~1B monthly tokens, that would be ideal. Also any notes on early termination, seat counts, or guaranteed minima would be helpful for our legal review.

We can do another 20-min sync Friday if that helps.

—Sam
CTO | Soloha
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: usage deck, credits path and committed-use options for Soloha

Aisha / Marissa — forwarding Sam's reply. Key asks: explicit committed-use comparison that demonstrates ~$600 / 1M at ~1B tokens, and legal questions on termination minima. My thinking: propose a founders starter credit (one-time) + 12mo ramped commit with an optional 12mo renewal that includes a step-down rebate if they exceed the band. That combination should get them inside the $500–$700 target without giving away a large multi-year discount up-front.

Questions for pricing/ops:
- Is a blended effective $/1M metric acceptable in the commercial proposal (embeddings vs generation weighted)?
- Can we model a 12mo commit with a 6mo ramp where guaranteed minimum is 60% of forecast for months 1–3, 85% for months 4–6, and full commit after month 6?

I'm happy to draft the committed-use examples; Aisha can lead on the front-facing summary + MAP. Marissa — if you think we should escalate founders credit to leadership, flag here.

-Ben
Head of Sales Economics | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sam Park <sam@soloha.ai>, Leila Gomez <leila@soloha.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage deck, credits path and committed-use options for Soloha

Sam / Leila — looping back with a short plan and next steps. Thanks for the transparency on the target band — helpful.

What we're sending you today (attached):
1) Committed-use comparison (12mo vs 24mo) with three scenarios: conservative (350M steady), base (ramp to 1B in 6mo), aggressive (1.2B+). Each scenario shows list price, applied founders credit (one-time), effective $/1M and monthly burn.
2) Draft MAP with milestones for pilot success criteria and procurement decision points.
3) Action items for legal: short summary of termination minima and suggested fallback (pay-as-you-go at list rate + pro-rated credit).

Immediate asks for Soloha: please confirm the 6mo ramp assumption for the base scenario and sign off on the MAP milestone dates so we can put together a 12mo commercial term sheet. If you want a quick walkthrough, Aisha and I can join a 20-minute sync Monday.

Sam: based on the numbers you shared, we can get you to an effective ~$610 / 1M in the base (1B) scenario with a 12mo ramp + founders starter credit. 24mo gives incremental improvement (~$540 / 1M) but requires a firmer multi-year commitment. The committed examples in the attachment show the math and pledge thresholds.

Looking forward —
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Pricing | Redwood Inference
